Welcome to Asra

A school where strong foundations come first

Asra Public School is a day school serving families from Early Years through Class 10. Our teaching pairs a clear, board-aligned curriculum with close attention to each student's progress — attendance, results and school notices are shared with families through our online portals, so nothing important is ever missed.

  • Structured curriculum with regular assessment and feedback
  • Qualified, caring teachers in every classroom
  • Attendance and results visible to students and parents online
  • A safe, respectful environment that values every child

More about our school

Academic highlights

Learning that builds, year by year

Three stages, one continuous journey — each with its own focus and the same high expectations.

Early Years & Primary (1–5)

Phonics-based literacy, hands-on numeracy and learning through play — the habits of reading, writing and asking questions start here.

Middle School (6–8)

Subject-specialist teaching begins: sciences split into lab work, mathematics deepens, and students take on projects and presentations.

Secondary (9–10)

Focused board-examination preparation with past-paper practice, revision plans and one-to-one guidance from subject teachers.

Facilities

Spaces made for learning

School Library

A quiet reading space with class sets, reference shelves and a weekly library period for every class.

Science Laboratories

Practical science from Class 6 upwards, with supervised experiments in physics, chemistry and biology.

Bright Classrooms

Well-lit, ventilated classrooms with sensible class sizes, so teachers can give every student attention.

Computer Lab

Weekly computing lessons covering typing, research skills, presentations and an introduction to programming.

Values alongside marks

About us

About Asra Public School

A community school with a simple promise: teach well, care deeply, and keep parents part of the journey.

Our story

Asra Public School was founded to give local families a school they could trust — one where academic standards are serious, teachers are approachable, and every child's progress is tracked and shared honestly.

Today the school teaches students from Early Years to Class 10, supported by a digital management system that keeps attendance, examinations and communication in one place for students, teachers and the school office.

Our vision

Confident, kind and capable young people

We want every Asra student to leave with strong academics, good character and the confidence to take the next step — in further study and in life.

Our mission

Teach well, every day, for every child

Planned lessons, honest assessment, regular feedback to families, and a school culture where effort is noticed and encouraged.

Educational philosophy

How we think about learning

Foundations first

Reading, writing and mathematics are mastered step by step. No student is rushed past a concept they have not understood.

Assessment that helps

Frequent low-stakes tests show teachers exactly where a student needs help — long before the final examination.

Character is curriculum

Respect, honesty and responsibility are taught deliberately, in assemblies, classrooms and daily school life.

Academics

Programmes, classes & subjects

A board-aligned curriculum from Early Years to Class 10, taught in stages that build on each other.

Academic programmes

Early Years (Nursery–KG)

Play-based learning, phonics, early numeracy, motor skills and social development in a warm, structured setting.

Primary (Classes 1–5)

English, Urdu, Mathematics, Science, Social Studies, Islamiyat, Computer and Art — with daily reading and mental-maths routines.

Middle (Classes 6–8)

Subject-specialist teachers, laboratory science, and the first steps toward independent study and research projects.

Secondary (Classes 9–10)

Science-group board programme: Physics, Chemistry, Biology or Computer Science, Mathematics, English, Urdu, Islamiyat and Pakistan Studies.

Assessment calendar

Two terms a year, each with class tests, a mid-term and a final examination. Results are published in the student portal.

Support & enrichment

Remedial periods for students who need them, plus societies, debates, spelling and science competitions for those ready to stretch.

Classes & core subjects

Every class follows the same core subject set, with specialist subjects added as students move up.

StageClassesCore subjectsAssessment
Early YearsNursery – KGPhonics, Early Maths, Rhymes, Art & PlayObservation-based
Primary1 – 5English, Urdu, Maths, Science, Social Studies, Islamiyat, ComputerTests + term exams
Middle6 – 8English, Urdu, Maths, Science, Social Studies, Islamiyat, Computer, ArtTests + term exams
Secondary9 – 10English, Urdu, Maths, Physics, Chemistry, Biology / Computer, Islamiyat, Pak StudiesBoard pattern

Our teaching approach

Lessons are planned against clear learning objectives, checked with short in-class questions, and followed up with marked homework. Termly result analysis helps teachers adjust teaching for the next term — and helps parents see exactly where their child stands.

  • Lesson plans reviewed by the Head of Academics
  • Regular class tests with feedback within the week
  • Practical work in science and computing labs
  • Parent–teacher meetings every term

Admissions

How to join Asra Public School

A simple four-step process. The school office confirms dates, fees and seat availability — contact details are on the Contact page.

The admission process

1

Enquire & visit

Contact the school office or visit the campus for a tour and a prospectus.

2

Submit the form

Complete the admission form and attach the required documents listed below.

3

Assessment & meeting

The student sits a short English and Mathematics assessment, followed by a family meeting.

4

Confirmation

On approval, pay the admission dues within the given time to confirm the seat. Portal login details are issued by the school office.

Requirements

  • Completed admission form
  • Copy of the child's birth certificate / B-Form
  • Copies of parents' CNIC
  • Previous school's report card and leaving certificate (Class 2 and above)
  • Two recent passport-size photographs

Good to know

Admissions are subject to seat availability in each class. Age requirements follow the applicable board and government guidelines for each class level.

Fee structure, sibling discounts and payment schedules are available from the school office — they are not published on this page until the office confirms them.

Student portal accounts are created only by the school administration. Students and parents receive their login details from the office after admission is confirmed.

Questions about admissions?

The school office is happy to help with forms, documents and visit timings.
